Signature Nutrition Program
Exclusive Nutrition for Leaders Who Cannot Afford Suboptimal Performance.
Apply for the Signature Nutrition Program
Nutrition and metabolic performance support for business leaders, where cognitive endurance and metabolic stability directly influence leadership performance. This program is structured, data-led, and designed for elite demands.
(3 clients per quarter, selective intake.)
Meenu Balaji · MHSc Food Science & Nutrition · 17+ years in the industry
·HPR ID 99-1467-6526-4626
Most senior professionals don't ignore their health, because it's fine.
They ignore it because it's still manageable.
You are not underperforming. You are performing at a discount.
Blood sugar variability is narrowing your decision window by mid-afternoon. Suboptimal sleep architecture is compressing your strategic thinking. Chronic low-grade inflammation is taxing your cognitive reserve, quietly, measurably, daily.
You are compensating with caffeine, habit, and discipline. That is not a system. That is debt.
If you're reading this, you're not functioning optimally, and you're compensating more than you realise.
That works, until it doesn't.
What you're telling yourself
BRANDING
"I'll deal with this once this quarter ends."
What's actually happening
STORYTELLING
"It's not bad enough yet, I can push through."
What the body is doing
DESIGN
Adapting to suboptimal inputs. Quietly. Every single day.
This is not about fixing a problem.
It is about stopping further damage, before it becomes irreversible.
What Clients Achieve in the Signature Program
Sharper Decisions
Reduce cognitive fatigue, blood sugar volatility and stress driven performance dips
Sustained Energy
Built for long workdays, travel and high-stakes thinking
Long term Health
Burnout, metabolic decline and hormone dysfunctions will cost you more in the long run
WHO THIS IS FOR
You don’t have a backup.
Your output sets the ceiling for everyone else.
You operate without recovery windows.
You’ve tried “clean eating” or standard plans with limited results
You want decisions backed by data, not trends
You travel, work long hours, or manage high cognitive load
You want fewer food decisions, not more rules
AND NOT FOR
You want a quick weight-loss plan
You are looking only for meal charts
You are not interested in diagnostics or feedback
You want a low-touch, check-in-only approach
Prefer generic plans over personalised work
You don't need a wellness program. You need a performance system. The signature program is built for one type of person.
CLIENT OUTCOMES
Results that speak
Cognition and Energy improved
★★★★★
"As a female entrepreneur, my work and travel was affecting my energy, decision making and hormonal health. 3 months into the program, I didn't have energy crashes any more. The menstrual health has improved and I feel like a new person "
Founder, Tech Start up, Maharashtra
Root cause identified · Off medication
★★★★★
As someone who manages a high profile role in the tech industry, Meenu's program has helped me understand my health better. The DNA and gut microbiome testing gave me deeper insights to my health and implement effective changes.
COO, Automotive sector, Chennai
Better energy · Hormone recovery
★★★★★
"I reached out to Meenu at a point where my work intensity was starting to show up physically. What stood out was how quickly she identified patterns I had normalised, irregular recovery, missed signals, and decisions I was postponing about my health.
Over the next few months, the work was structured, realistic, and easy to sustain alongside a demanding schedule. My hormonal markers improved, my energy stabilised, and the excess weight came down steadily without disruption."
Founder, Jewellery design, Maharashtra
★★★★★
HbA1C reduced · Cognitive function improved
"As a media company head, I have been working with Meenu for 6 months. I observe a great change in my energy and cogntive function. My travel nutrition is planned ahead and my HbA1C has also improved.
Founder, Media company, Chennai
Individual results depend on condition, adherence and baseline health. The following are self-reported by clients of Pragmatic Nutrition.
Program Inclusions
01 · Personal blood work review
Your blood work is coordinated, reviewed, and interpreted personally by Meenu, with context from your symptoms, history, and goals, not auto-generated reports or generic ranges.
• Home sample collection available
• Indicative standalone value: ₹4,000+
04 · Direct clinical reviews with Meenu
There are two focused review consultations each month. These are structured, prepared sessions where your data has already been reviewed and decisions are made with purpose.
• Two reviews per month
• No junior coaches or handovers
• Structured, decision-led format
02 · Body composition tracking
We track what actually changes, not just body weight.
Using advanced body composition analysis, we assess fat mass, muscle mass, visceral fat and hydration patterns at baseline and every fortnight. This allows decisions to be based on data, not assumptions.
05 · Monthly plan evolution
Once a month, your nutrition protocol is formally reviewed and adjusted based on symptom patterns, lab markers and body composition trends. This allows the body enough time to respond while keeping the plan relevant.
• Evidence-led progression
• Thoughtful, not reactive
• Built for long-term outcomes
03 · Functional assessment
One advanced diagnostic test is included, selected based on your clinical picture n,ot as an add-on.
Gut microbiome analysis to understand digestion, inflammation, immunity and energy patterns
DNA nutrigenomics to understand genetic responses to nutrients and metabolism
• Indicative value:
₹15,000–₹45,000
06 · Structured support between sessions
Between reviews, you have access to Meenu through a clinically guided support channel for questions that genuinely need input.
This is not constant messaging or dependency-driven support. It is designed to help you think better, not lean harder.
• WhatsApp or email on working days
• For substantive, decision-relevant queries
• Focused on building independence
Engagements typically begin at ₹1.25 lakh for a 24-week period
DEPENDING ON DIAGNOSTIC DEPTH AND PERFORMANCE GOALS· SELECTIVE INTAKE ONLY
The diagnostics alone carry a standalone value of ₹50,000+. What you are paying for beyond that is 24 weeks of direct, senior-level clinical attention, with no handovers and no generic plans

Frequently asked questions
What is included in the Signature Nutrition Programme?
The Signature Programme includes a comprehensive blood panel, body composition analysis, gut microbiome testing or DNA nutrigenomics (clinically selected by Meenu), two 20-minute monthly review consultations with Meenu directly, monthly plan adaptation, and structured WhatsApp or email support between sessions. Every element is coordinated and interpreted personally by Meenu Balaji across 24 weeks.
How much does the Signature Nutrition Programme cost?
The engagement typically begins at ₹1.25 lakhs, depending on the diagnostic pathway selected. As every client receives either advanced microbiome testing or DNA nutrigenomics along with personalised review and support, the final pricing is discussed during the application process.
Is this programme available online across India?
Yes. The programme is fully online across India and internationally — including the UK, USA, New Zealand, Australia, UAE and Canada. Diagnostic testing kits are couriered directly to your door.
Do I work directly with Meenu or will I be assigned to someone else?
You work directly with Meenu Balaji throughout the entire program, not a junior associate or delegate. She reviews your diagnostics, designs your clinical plan, conducts every consultation and remains your sole point of clinical contact from week 1 to week 24.
How many clients does Meenu accept at one time?
Meenu accepts three clients per quarter. This is deliberate, it ensures every client receives her full clinical attention. Intake is selective and confirmed personally by Meenu.
What diagnostic tests are included?
The program includes a comprehensive blood panel (CBC, thyroid, diabetes profile, fasting insulin, iron studies, vitamin D, B12, lipids, liver and kidney function, and inflammatory markers), body composition analysis (fortnightly), and either gut microbiome testing or DNA nutrigenomics.
I travel frequently and have a demanding schedule. Will this work for me?
Yes, the program is designed specifically for high-performing professionals with complex, unpredictable schedules. Consultations are online, plans are built around your real calendar, and you will have decision frameworks for travel, client dinners and high-pressure weeks in advance so you always know what to do.
What results can I expect and how quickly?
Most clients report measurable reductions in bloating and digestive discomfort around 6 to 8 weeks. 91% of clients report improvement around the eight-week mark. Body composition and lab markers are tracked objectively, so progress is visible throughout. Individual results vary.
Is this a medical program?
No. The Signature Nutrition Program provides nutritional and wellness support and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Meenu Balaji is a qualified clinical nutritionist practising in India (HPR ID: 99-1467-6526-4626). If you have an existing medical condition, please consult your physician alongside this program.
Pragmatic Nutrition works with a small number of founders, CEOs, and high-responsibility professionals on metabolic performance and long-term health.
